notes: v190: HD Voice Pack — natural human voices for ATLAS and every world leader (Kokoro neural voices, about 125 MB, downloaded once and works offline). Offered the first time you start a game; also in Settings → HD Voice Pack, where you can pick ATLAS's voice or remove the pack. Leaders get accents by region, voices that suit them, and emotion in their delivery; their opening line is prepared while the phone rings. The installed PC app now runs the voices on several CPU cores.
